title: Email Outreach Manager
jobDescription:
JD: Email & Outreach Manager We are looking for email marketing specialists who can generate leads and demand for our products. They should know how to build & manage databases, plan and create an email schedule and calendar, craft email ...

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own, Create & Drive the entire strategy for email outreach, lead nurture, and lead generation. Develop and implement an email outreach & nurture plan, content & calendar for existing leads (leads, customers, and ex-customers) acquired through our website and various channels. Craft and execute (content, design and calendar) an outreach and lead generation strategy for new databases Build and cultivate Database : Use online tools to build new databases to which messages can be sent. Design and deploy emails: Responsible for creating the email plan and calendar, creating the email content work with design team for design and HTML for the emailer and deploy the same to the required database (or data-segment) Build and maintain a multi-geo, multi-industry email calendar, creating engaging content that fosters strong contact engagement. Manage all contacts within the CRM, ensuring adherence to best practices and data hygiene. Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce, Hubspot) is a must, with the ability to maintain and optimize data within the platform. Possess strong analytical skills , responsible for tracking and reporting on various email marketing KPIs and overall campaign performance. Lead and mentor a team of marketing professionals (if applicable). Embrace growth hacking principles to leverage email marketing for lead generation and maximize campaign impact.

QUALIFICATIONS:
5+ years of experience in email marketing and outreach campaigns. Email Marketing tools and Salesforce Pardot Understanding is a must. Proven track record of developing and implementing successful email marketing strategies that drive measurable results (increased open rates, click-through rates, conversions). Strong understanding of email marketing best practices and compliance regulations (e.g., CAN-SPAM). Strong understanding of the technicalities involved in email marketing framework setup, like Domain DNS records (SPF, DKIM markers etc), Email Warmup, Email limits, Spam and Bounce thresholds. Excellent copywriting and content creation skills with the ability to craft compelling email copy that resonates with target audiences. Experience with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Hub Spot, Marketo) is a plus. Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce or Hubspot) is essential. Strong analytical skills with the ability to track, analyze, and report on email marketing data. Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills. Must know HTML as editing email templates is a requirement Must know and understand Google Analytics (GA4) and GTM from setup to Bonus Points: Experience with social media marketing (particularly Linked In outreach). Knowledge of multi-lingual email marketing strategies. Experience with growth hacking techniques for email marketing. RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the overall product ...

Own the overall product messaging and positioning w.r.t to the overall market and specific industry verticals. BTW, Satya Nadella (CEO of Microsoft) was once a Technical Marketing Manager, a very similar role.
2. Extend our core platform vision to target specific personas and industry verticals with inspiring and incisive messaging that showcases our product innovation and thought leadership.
3. Own and drive key product marketing initiatives such as competitive analysis, market research, and product releases.
4. Present / Communicate these product updates, feature updates, and all the competitive analysis by way of owning the updates on the Product Website, Pages and Sales Collaterals
5. Sales enablement – Communicate the value proposition of Muvi products to sales teams and develop sales tools that support the selling process efficiently. Create and help create sales collateral including product landing pages, product brochures and presentations
6. Work with the broader marketing team to develop campaigns to carry products to market (e.g., webinars, online branding campaigns, and videos).
7. Product launch – plan the communication of new product releases and manage the cross-functional implementation of the product launch plan. title: Database Administrator
jobDescription:
Mysql Database Administrator (Mysql, Mongo DB and Elasticsearch): We are looking for an experienced My SQL database administrator who will be responsible for ensuring a high performance, availability, and security of My SQL instances. You must have experience in other No SQL databases like ...

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Install, configure, monitor, upgrade and maintain databases in production and non-production environments. Have hands on experience in Mysql and No Sql databases like Mongo DB and Elastic search 24/7 Support all failover with High Availability Disaster Recovery environment with My SQL native Replication. Owning the Database Maintenance activities e.g Profile server resource usage, optimize and tweak as necessary Troubleshooting Database issues on all levels: data corruption, data restore, data backup, recovery of offline databases, statement-level analysis. Ensure performance, security, and availability of databases Prepare documentations to enforce it across the organization that helps developers Handle common database procedures, such as upgrade, backup, recovery, migration, etc. Coordinate with other team members and stakeholders. Drive any critical updates related to database failover. Identify and drive to fix all issues in databases i.e Slow Queries, database structure changes etc Requirements: 5+ years of experience as DBA in My SQL, Mongo DB, Elastic or similar technologies. Strong knowledge in My SQL database management, Relational schema definitions, Integrity constraints, Replication cluster, Log management to identify quickly the database issues Strong understanding of My SQL database fundamentals and query optimization i.e Query plan analysis, Full table scan optimizations, Query worker analysis, Query caching, Complex SQL queries with multiple joins, Views and stored procedures etc Must have strong knowledge of No SQL databases for Concurrency and lock performance monitoring, Wired Tiger for Mongo, Global Locks and Locks Must have experience related to performance tuning i.e Clustered and Non clustered Indexing, Sharding and Partitioning concepts, Versioned data rows and periodic data archival from transactional tables Must have strong communication and interpersonal skills Job Features Job Category Software Development Apply Online Full Name * Email * Phone * Attach Resume * Submit Please, don't leave us!
